svg.text: Eleven gates. At each, the same resolution order: mechanical first and unwaivable,
then model production, then human authority. Reading down is time; across is who may act.
The empty cells at G5 and G7a are the design, not an omission.
Mechanical — runs first, cannot be overridden
the classification is fail-closed: absent or ambiguous resolves to confirmatory
skips G2b — may never claim confirmatory
unless the model is the subject
it reproduces or it does not
a material signal reopens the protocol
None of this lifecycle is implemented. The only working component today is the literature bridge that feeds G3;
every other cell above is a design commitment, and no work package has reached ACCEPTED.
